about_the_game:
Kuromaku- is a psychological thriller horror game where ordinary routine becomes the only line between safety and something far more sinister. Left alone in a new house for the weekend, you’ll live through three nights of rising tension as the familiar slowly warps into the unknown. Your choices shape how the story unfolds and which truth you’ll have to face.

You'll do interactive daily chores—cleaning, appliance checks, and running errands—that both move the day forward and reveal new evidence. Search rooms, examine objects, and gather evidence to learn what's going on; environmental challenges and secret goals reveal deeper levels of the story. A lurking presence haunts the borders of the house: whether you choose to confront, avoid, or conceal it matters, and your choices have tangible repercussions. Time and mood alter the landscape as you play, transforming mundane actions into challenges of temperament that drive the game toward a variety of potential conclusions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 3GB / AMD RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Designed for gameplay at 1080p, High settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for 1080p/1440p, High–Epic settings
